data.name: Usage
data.value:
usage: ShaderRipper --game <dataDir|gameRoot> [outDir] [options] ShaderRipper --file <path[,;path|wildcard]>... [outDir] [options] ShaderRipper --asm <file.dxbc.asm> [--out <file.hlsl>] ShaderRipper --glsl <file.glsl> [--shaderlab] ShaderRipper --emit <dir> <outDir> ShaderRipper --stats <dir-with-asm-files> ShaderRipper --list-shaders <file> ShaderRipper --dump <file> [--dump-filter <text>]
Export: --shaderlab write <Name>.shader (the deliverable) --programs also write per-program HLSL into <Name>/ folders --orig-asm also write the original disassembly / GLSL into them --out <dir> output directory (default "<input>_Ripped") --jobs <N> translate N shaders at once (default: logical cores) --overwrite empty the output directory first (alias --clean), so one path can be reused instead of one folder per run --no-dedup keep every copy of a shader (default: one copy per path) --builtin include Unity's own shaders as well --only <text> only shaders whose name contains this --self-contained inline the engine declarations instead of #include (compiles standalone; Unity will reject it on import)
Name tables: --tmp-layouts <file|dir> TMP layout rows (JSON) --builtin-index <file> Unity's own shader list --no-tmp-layout ignore the TMP layout rows
Other: --quiet only the final tally --verbose per-file headings, structure and timings --lang <en|zh> interface language (default: system UI language) -h, --help show this help
data.comment: Command-line usage text. Keep the alignment: the options are column-aligned.

data.name: UsageFile
data.comment: Printed when --file is given without any input path.

data.name: UnknownOption
data.comment: {0} = the unrecognised argument

data.name: ExportSummary
data.value: files={0} shaders={1} emitted={2} programs={3} disassembled={4} translated={5} skipped={6} failed={7}
data.comment: One-line export tally. Files read, shaders seen, shaders written, programs translated.

data.name: OverwriteCleared
data.comment: --overwrite deleted the previous run's output before writing. {0} directory, {1} count.

data.name: OverwriteRefused
data.value: --overwrite refuses to empty {0}: it looks like a game install (it holds a *_Data folder). Pick a different output directory.
data.comment: Safety stop: the target is an input, not an export. {0} directory.

data.name: OverwriteForeign
data.value: --overwrite refuses to empty {0}: it holds files this tool did not write ({1}). Point it at an export directory, or delete the contents yourself.
data.comment: Safety stop: the target is not exclusively a previous export. {0} directory, {1} example names.

data.name: OverwriteBusy
data.value: --overwrite could not empty {0}: {1} is still in use (close whatever is holding it, then rerun). Nothing was written.
data.comment: An entry inside the export directory could not be deleted. {0} directory, {1} entry name.

data.name: ExportSummaryBuiltinSkipped
data.comment: Appended to ExportSummary when Unity's own shaders were filtered out. Leading space is deliberate.

data.name: Note
data.comment: One diagnostic note, indented under the summary.

data.name: AsmSummary
data.comment: Statistics for --asm on a single disassembly.

data.name: AsmMissingHandlers
data.comment: {0} = comma-separated opcode list

data.name: GlslParseErrors
data.comment: GLSL translator error count.

data.name: ShaderLabWellFormed
data.comment: The generated ShaderLab parses back cleanly.

data.name: ShaderLabErrors
data.comment: {0} = semicolon-separated parse errors

data.name: EmitAllSummary
data.comment: --emit tally.

data.name: StatsSummary
data.comment: --stats: corpus file counts.

data.name: StatsInstructions
data.comment: --stats: instruction coverage. {3} is already formatted to one decimal.

data.name: StatsNoHandler
data.comment: --stats: opcodes with no emitter.

data.name: ListShadersSummary
data.comment: --list-shaders tally, printed to stderr so stdout stays a clean list.

data.name: DumpFileHeader
data.comment: --dump: one heading per serialized file.

data.name: DumpShaderSummary
data.comment: --dump: per-shader counts.

data.name: DumpPlatforms
data.comment: --dump: the platform list a shader ships.

data.name: DumpOrigin
data.comment: --dump: where the shader came from and what it falls back to.

data.name: DumpNone
data.comment: Stand-in for a missing optional value in --dump output.

data.name: DumpEntryError
data.comment: A file that could not be read during --list-shaders / --dump.

data.name: ResourcesMapNotFound
data.comment: No Resources.Load path table; shaders are named after themselves.

data.name: ResourcesMapLoaded
data.comment: {0} = how many (file, pathID) -> path mappings were recovered.

data.name: ResourcesMapFrom
data.comment: {0} = globalgamemanagers path, reported when it is not in the directory the user named.

data.name: ResourcesMapError
data.comment: {0} = the exception message

data.name: DedupSummary
data.comment: --dedup tally.

data.name: PathTaken
data.comment: Two shaders resolved to the same file; the second got a suffix.

data.name: ShaderLabNotWellFormed
data.comment: A shader whose generated ShaderLab failed the parse-back check, so nothing was written.

data.name: PlanErrors
data.comment: {0} = a planning-stage message (which input is read, what was chosen)

data.name: LogInfo
data.comment: Level tag: a shader was written.

data.name: LogRead
data.comment: Level tag: one input file was parsed, followed by how many shaders it held.

data.name: LogWarn
data.comment: Level tag: something the export had to work around.

data.name: LogError
data.comment: Level tag: a shader could not be written.

data.name: LogSkip
data.comment: Level tag: a shader left out on purpose (Unity's own).

data.name: LogDup
data.comment: Level tag: a duplicate copy dropped by --dedup.

data.name: LogReadShaders
data.comment: {0} = how many shaders the file in the same line contained.

data.name: LogSkipBuiltin
data.comment: Why a shader was skipped: it is one of Unity's own.

data.name: LogKeptFrom
data.comment: {0} = the path of the copy that was kept.

data.name: LogThisCopy
data.comment: {0} = the source file of the discarded copy.

data.name: LogKeptSource
data.comment: {0} = path, {1} = source file.

data.name: LogStructure
data.comment: Per-shader structure counts, printed under the info line when verbose.

data.name: LogStructureTarget
data.comment: {0} = the structure line, {1} = shader model like 4.0

data.name: LogElapsed
data.comment: {0} = elapsed milliseconds

data.name: WarnPassNoProgram
data.value: pass {0} has no program in the build
data.comment: {0} = pass label such as "#0" or "0 \"Main\""

data.name: WarnPassNoVertex
data.value: pass {0} ships only a fragment program - a fullscreen vertex program was supplied
data.comment: {0} = pass label; the vertex program had to be synthesised.
